description: This file declares the StateHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which manages lifecycle state transitions, creation, and validation for a plugin component. It includes static methods and static member variables related to state management.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: A class providing static methods and members to handle lifecycle state transitions, creation, and validation within the plugin.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the StateHandler, potentially setting up internal state or resources.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Attempts to change the lifecycle state based on a request, returning success status and error reason.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a new State object based on the application context and target lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Checks if transitioning from start to target state is valid within the defined state transition map.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the current state of the application context to the specified lifecycle state.
